units.meaning: An applicant is prohibited from continuing to use a previous name following a material name change, unless an exception applies.

source_spans.quote: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change

units.meaning: An applicant is permitted to continue using a previous name after a material name change if the documentation for the name change specifically authorizes the applicant to continue using that name.

source_spans.quote: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name
The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change

units.meaning: Provides an internal cross-reference to 8 FAM 403.1-6 for information on 'known as' names; contains no operational requirement or restriction.
The adjudicator/official must clear the applicant's pending name regardless of whether the name change is not yet final and regardless of whether the passport is not being issued at that time.

source_spans.quote: You must clear the applicant's pending name even though the name change is not final and even if the passport is not being issued at this time.
